metadata.description: Small mods for Claude Code: a kitchen that keeps your prompt cache warm, and a line that shows where the answer starts.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps your prompt cache warm while you are away, shown as a tiny kitchen where a chef feeds one guest per hour.

plugins.name: answer-divider
plugins.description: Marks where Claude's final answer starts, dims the interim text, and shows how long the turn took.
